notes: ESG (Esther Greek additions) sits at a point of double divergence: the Vulgate places these as Esther chapters 10-16, while English publishes them as Greek additions A-F numbered 1-6. We re-chapter the Arabic at extraction time so both translations use the additions A-F scheme — see ingest/data/snapshots/ar/ESG.json _provenance block.
After re-chaptering, only 4 of 6 chapters diverge in verse count, all with small (±1-6) deltas reflecting Vulgate prayer/letter expansions vs the LXX:
ESG.1 (Addition A — Mordecai's dream): ar 17v vs en 18v. Vulgate compresses one verse.
ESG.3 (Addition C — Mordecai+Esther prayers): ar 30v vs en 24v. Vulgate's prayer text is famously longer.
ESG.4 (Addition D — Esther's audience): ar 19v vs en 22v. en/LXX expands the audience-with-the-king scene.
ESG.5 (Addition E — second royal letter): ar 24v vs en 21v. Vulgate adds 3 verses of imperial flourish.
